figures.caption: Table 1. Classification accuracy (%) on the Office-Home dataset on methods that use the ResNet-50 backbone. SPACE (Ours) is shown in the final block. The best result for each task among all ResNet-50 methods (top block and ours) is in bold.

Fig. 1. Overview of the proposed CLIP-based domain alignment framework. Class prompts are encoded by the CLIP text encoder to construct an orthogonal semantic basis via SVD. Source and target images are encoded by the CLIP visual encoder and decomposed into semantic projections onto this basis and orthogonal residual components. Semantic projections are used to form class prototypes and to perform classification using source labels and target pseudo-labels, while residual features capturing domain-specific variation are aligned across domains using the MMD loss.
